<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 179.0946, which likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is approximately 178.087 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern is C₉H₁₀N₂O₂. This fits the required format.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10N2O2</final_answer>
